West-Style Melody Analysis - Iliad Book 1
============================================================

Rule Key:
  H1: Circumflex descent (two notes, high→low)
  H3: Line opens on c'
  H5: Stepwise motion only
  E1: Feet 4-6 (second half) → c'
  E2: Maximum 3 e' per line
  E3: Content words (noun/adj/part/pron) → e'; function words → c'
  F2: Circumflex stricter gate (feet 1-2 only for e')
  G2: One e' per word maximum
  U1-U4: Unaccented syllable rules
  CAD1: Standard cadence (→ a,a)
  CAD2: Final acute cadence (→ b,c')

------------------------------------------------------------
Line 1: μῆ νιν ἄ ει δε θε ὰ Πη λη ϊ ά δεω Ἀ χι λῆ ος
------------------------------------------------------------

#   Syllable     Foot  Accent   Pitch      Reason
--- ------------ ----- -------- ---------- ----------------------------------------
0   μῆ           1     circ     c'→b       H3: line opens on c'
                                           ↳ H1: circumflex descent c'→b
1   νιν          1     -        b          U3: post-circumflex continuation → b
2   ἄ            1     acute    c'         E3: acute on function word 'ἄειδε' (verb) → c'
3   ει           2     -        b          U4: unaccented in foot 2 ≤ 2 → c' [strict H2: lowered c'→b]
4   δε           2     -        b          U4: unaccented in foot 2 ≤ 2 → c' [strict H2: lowered c'→b]
5   θε           2     -        c'         U1/H6: launch pad before e' → c'
6   ὰ            3     fin-acu  e'         E3: final-acute on content word 'θεὰ' (noun) → e'
7   Πη           3     -        c'         U2: post-e' descent → c'
8   λη           4     -        b          U4: unaccented in foot 4 (4-5) → b
9   ϊ            4     -        b          U4: unaccented in foot 4 (4-5) → b
10  ά            4     acute    c'         E1: acute in foot 4 (second half) → c'
11  δεω          5     -        b          U4: unaccented in foot 5 (4-5) → b
12  Ἀ            5     -        b          U4: unaccented in foot 5 (4-5) → b
13  χι           5     -        b          U4: unaccented in foot 5 (4-5) → b
14  λῆ           6     circ     c'→b       E1: circumflex in foot 6 (second half) → c'
                                           ↳ H1/E4: circumflex descent c'→b
15  ος           6     -        a          CAD1: standard cadence → a
